note: Genuinely complete, report-only, against the authoritative contract. Proves the sound gate is not always-RED for the scope leg. Built at run time (build_report_fixture) rather than declared: this used to be a static manifest at HEAD..HEAD, and an empty declared range is now refused, because a unit that changed production code in commit C can assert base = head = C just as easily as an honest report can (#310, PR #308 review). So the control has to SHOW the honest shape instead of asserting it -- two real commits whose whole difference is a document.
